page.overview:
What is Alien Beetle?

At least one alien beetle was present aboard the United Systems Military medical research vessel as of 2381. It was crushed by a USM soldier

The Alien Beetle appears in the alternate opening seen in the Special Edition of Alien Resurrection. In the novelization of the film, it is Vinnie Distephano that encounters the insect in the command capsule rather than the unnamed crewmember seen in the alternate opening.
